annotations.title: Draft a cover letter and application answers

description: Job Spotter. Draft a cover letter and application answers. For "write my cover letter for this job" or "help me answer these application questions". Builds a first draft only from the person's own CV lines and the advert: the strongest matching achievements, the skills the job asks for in the CV's own words, an honest gap line, and draft answers to the form's questions. Anything only the person can know is left as a [bracketed] prompt. Job Spotter never applies or sends anything, and nothing sent is stored.

availability.description: When they could start, for example "I can start in May".

company.description: The employer's name, when the advert is pasted as job_text.

cv.description: The CV as plain text. Optional if titles and skills are given.

employers.description: Current and past employers, comma separated.

id.description: A job id from a search result, copied exactly. Or give job_text.

job_text.description: The job advert as plain text, when there is no id.

location.description: Where the person lives or wants to work.

questions.description: Application form questions to draft answers for, one per line. Common questions are used if left out.

titles.description: Current and past job titles, comma separated.

why_company.description: One specific reason they want this employer, in their words. Left as a gap to fill in if not given.

your_name.description: The person's name, to sign the letter.
